newsitem.title: CANADA: MAAX says signs C$15-20 mln in contracts.
newsitem.headline: MAAX says signs C$15-20 mln in contracts.

text.p: MAAX Inc said on Tuesday that it concluded in recent weeks commercial agreements that will add C$15-20 million to annual sales next year.

The first category of agreements consists of contracts valued at C$10-15 million annually relating to the sale of ABS thermoplastic and fiberglass products to one of the largest builders of manufactured housing units in the United States, the company said.
MAAX also signed an agreement which should generate annual sales of C$ 5million with a major chain of home improvement centers in the American Midwest, the company said,
